title: Aether Evidence Manifest
description: Canonical evidence-manifest schema for the Aether certification plane. A manifest records the current certification state of one capability together with the human-reviewed evidence that backs it. The certificationState enum is the single binding target declared by readiness-vocabulary.json (certificationStateEnumPointer = #/$defs/certificationState/enum); every token here is a certification-category vocabulary token, ranked and ordered exactly as readiness-vocabulary.json defines. presentation-category tokens (stale, partial, error, connection_testing, credential_required, credential_invalid, not_entitled, not_configured, kill_switch_active) are never valid certification states and never appear in this enum.

stateRank.description: Ordinal rank of the certification state; must agree with the rank the vocabulary assigns to the token.

evidence.description: Human-reviewed evidence backing the certification state.

source.description: Where the evidence was collected (PR, test run, replay fixture, live probe, external audit).

payload.description: Evidence-specific details (fixture path, tx hash, probe result, reviewer).

audited.description: Whether an independent reviewer confirmed this evidence.
